## Summary
- Adds `"claude"` to the `execution.agent` enum in `docs/03-reference/spec/dopetask/dopetask-canonical-spec.json` — task packets that explicitly direct Claude Code as the primary implementer can now record that in `execution.agent` instead of falling back to the generic `"shell"` value and noting the real executing tool only in free-text invariants (lossy for routing, PR Steward, and proof aggregation, which read `execution.agent` programmatically).
- Updates the one place that hard-copies the enum in prose, `docs/03-reference/governance/codex-macro-packet-blueprint.md`, to match.
- No model-tier variants (`claude-sonnet`/`claude-opus`) added — surveyed all 146 packets in `task-packets/generated/*.json` and found zero existing precedent for tier granularity in `execution.agent` (even `claude/*`-branch packets record a bare `codex` or `gemini`), so `claude` follows the existing flat tool-name convention.
- Schema-only change, split out per TP-DMX-FDOS-004 §4.2 which forbade changing the canonical schema in-packet.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('docs/03-reference/spec/dopetask/dopetask-canonical-spec.json'))"` — valid JSON
- [x] `python -m jsonschema -i <file> docs/03-reference/spec/dopetask/dopetask-canonical-spec.json` run against all 146 files in `task-packets/generated/*.json` — 143 pass; the same 3 pre-existing failures remain (unrelated to `execution.agent`: missing `repo_binding`/`series`/`commit`/`pr`/`steps`, or unexpected fields like `starting_head`/`body_update`/`embedded_audit`), confirming the change is purely additive and breaks nothing

commits.messageBody:
Task packets are now explicitly authored to direct Claude Code as the
primary implementer, but the canonical schema only allowed gemini,
codex, vibe, and shell, forcing those packets to fall back to "shell"
and note the real executing tool only in free-text invariants — lossy
for any downstream tooling (routing, PR Steward, proof aggregation)
that reads execution.agent programmatically.

No model-tier variants (sonnet/opus) added: a survey of all 146
packets in task-packets/generated/ found zero existing precedent for
tier granularity in this field — even claude/* branch packets record
a bare "codex" or "gemini" agent — so "claude" follows the same flat
tool-name convention.

Validated against all 146 generated task packets with jsonschema; the
change is purely additive (widens the enum) and introduces no new
validation failures versus the pre-existing baseline.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
